title: The Little Hands of Antwerp: Unsupervised Writer Identification in a Visual Corpus of Vernacular Aldermen Deeds (ca. 1300-1350) — code, data and model
description: Code, corpus data and trained model supporting the paper "The Little Hands of Antwerp. Unsupervised Writer Identification in a Visual Corpus of Vernacular Aldermen Deeds (ca. 1300-1350)" (CHR 2027, Manchester). Includes the self-supervised (AttMask/ViT) pretraining code, the analysis notebooks reproducing the paper's figures and tables, the deed and Flanders page images, PAGE-XML transcriptions and extracted plain text, VLAD document embeddings, the trained ViT checkpoint, the master clustering and human annotations, and the interactive UMAP/HDBSCAN visualisation. See the README in the accompanying GitHub repository for structure and reproduction instructions.
